name: hmm-hmm-static
description: AI Studio preview runner for the standalone Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS HMM HMM app (not needed for cPanel upload).

scripts.build: node -e "console.log('Static HTML/CSS/JS ready (no build step required).')"
scripts.lint: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process');for(const f of fs.readdirSync('js').filter(x=>x.endsWith('.js'))){cp.execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check','js/'+f]);}console.log('All classic scripts valid.');"
